title: Decision Arena replay: /arena/<case>/<decider> plays a frozen result as a reading
acceptance: /arena/<caseId>/<decider> (openai, jev, kev, rules) loads /content/arena/index.json and its run file only when opened, and plays the first run's admitted decision for that case and decider through the same reading gate, with no model call.
A frozen decision is admitted only under its own label, rise/arena-replay-1 with provider RISE, keeping the original model as sourceModel; other unknown labels are still refused.

Four plain-text deciders (A · OpenAI Decisions, B · TypeSafe Jev, C · Kev, D · rules, no model) switch the same case one reading at a time; a decider with no admitted decision reads 'not run' or 'rejected: <code>' as text; the page states the capture date and that there is no partnership with OpenAI or TypeSafe.
A missing index or run file, or a case the run lacks, opens Home; first load stays within the 64 KB brotli budget.
Seth or Mateo plays a real frozen run at rise.syberlabs.io/arena/<case>/<decider> after the billed capture lands.

evidence.note: Branch arena/replay: 3 passed with url-routing.spec.js (9 passed) on a private port, 2026-10-08, against a test fixture run (src/test/arena-run.fixture.js); no real run yet.
